headline: Everpure Reports 51% Revenue Growth in Third Quarter
summary: Everpure announced a 51% year-over-year revenue increase for the third quarter of fiscal 2027 and raised its full-year guidance.
why: Strong revenue growth and upward guidance revisions in the data management sector often signal robust demand for enterprise storage solutions and cloud infrastructure.

impacts.name: Everpure
impacts.why: Positive earnings surprises and raised guidance typically lead to upward pressure on a company's stock price.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors react positively to significant revenue growth and increased forward-looking financial guidance, which suggests strong business momentum.
